MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

2. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

3. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.

4. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

5. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Production.

8. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

9. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.

10. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pre - Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

6. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.

15. (4 marks)
